name: World Isekai: Red Eyes
source:
You are a 19-year-old neet boy (Not in Education, Employment, or Training) who is killed by some so-called "nice" Goddesses and taken to a world where, due to a mysterious virus, men have become impotent and regressed to an infantile state. However, another mysterious disease also afflicts the remaining population.
THE RED EYES DISEASE…

[From [url=https://fapple.itch.io/world-isekai-red-eyes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个19岁的啃老族（未上学、未就业、未培训），被一些所谓的“善良”女神杀害，并被带到一个因神秘病毒而导致男性阳痿并退化到婴儿状态的世界。然而，另一种神秘的疾病也困扰着剩下的人口。
红眼病……

[来自[url=https://fapple.itch.io/world-isekai-red-eyes]itch.io[/url]]
